errors.combineTimeout: The combine is still running in the export queue. Refresh your clips when it completes.
errors.prepareTimeout: Source preparation is taking longer than expected. Reopen the editor to check its status.
errors.transcriptTooLong: Edit this long transcript one word at a time.
errors.cannotEncode: This browser cannot encode this video. Choose background export to render it on the server.
errors.cannotLoadSource: Could not load the source video.
errors.canvasUnavailable: Canvas is unavailable. Use background export.
errors.cannotDecode: This browser cannot decode the source. Use background export.
errors.audioEncodeUnavailable: Audio encoding is unavailable. Use background export.
errors.sourceIncomplete: We couldn't fetch the whole source video for this clip, so we didn't open it with footage missing. Retry in a minute.
errors.uploadShorter: The original upload is shorter than this clip, so it can't be opened for editing.
errors.rebuildBusy: Wait for the current preparation or export to finish, then rebuild.
errors.rebuildConflict: This draft changed in another tab. Reload it before rebuilding.
errors.noBackup: No earlier draft is kept for this clip.

captions.saveFailed: Could not save style on this device

captions.scriptHint: Existing words keep their timing. Review the timing of inserted words.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: Drag the video in the preview to keep your subject in focus.
framing.landscapeHint: This clip contains wide detail. A landscape version keeps it readable without cropping content.

audioPanel.title: Audio
audioPanel.description: Audio changes are included in your export.
audioPanel.noTrack: This clip has no audio track.
audioPanel.boostWarning: Boosting quiet audio can clip loud peaks. Listen through before exporting.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: Effects apply to the video. Captions stay crisp.

preview.fontError: Caption font could not load. Check your connection before exporting.
preview.framingHint: Drag the video to reframe · captions stay in place
preview.captionHint: Drag text to move · drag a corner to resize · click to edit
preview.title: Preview
preview.safeAreaTip: Show where platform UI covers the video

export.queuedAll: Clips added to the export queue
export.title: Ready for the feed
export.description: Export your current edit. Background exports keep running when you leave.
export.opusNote: This browser uses Opus audio in MP4. Background export provides wider player compatibility with AAC audio.

refusal.warp: Speed ramps and freeze frames render on the server. Use background export.
refusal.reaction: Reaction GIFs render on the server. Use background export.
refusal.behind: Text behind the speaker renders on the server. Use background export.

workspace.keepLocal: Your draft is kept locally. Save it before switching clips.
workspace.styleApplied: Caption style applied to all clips
workspace.combined: Combined draft created. Original clips are unchanged.
workspace.storageFull: This browser's storage for SupoClip is full, so it can't keep a backup copy of your latest changes. Your edits still save to your account: wait for “All changes saved” before you close this tab.
workspace.combineHint: Uses selection order and the first clip’s style. Originals are kept.
workspace.combineOneMore: Select one more clip to combine.
workspace.combineEmpty: Tick two or more clips to combine them into one draft.
workspace.draftNote: Generated clips are never overwritten. Every change here is an editable draft.
workspace.previewBackDetail: Your original clip is safe. Retry preparation to continue.
workspace.preparingDetail: Loading the original video, word timings, thumbnails, and audio waveform. This only happens once per clip.
workspace.shortcutsDescription: Shortcuts work whenever you’re outside a text field.
workspace.restoreDescription: This resets cuts, captions, framing, audio, and effects. You can undo this action.
workspace.reloadDescription: This replaces local changes and undo history with the server draft. Back up your draft first if you want to keep your local changes.

shortcuts.removeSelection: Remove the selected B-roll or edit

broll.title: B-roll
broll.description: Stock footage shown over the clip while the speaker keeps talking. Captions stay on top.
broll.empty: No B-roll yet. Auto-fill picks moments from what's said, or search below.
broll.replaceDescription: Pick footage to use instead. The timing stays the same.
broll.searchDescription: Search stock videos and pick one to add at the playhead ({time}).
broll.searchPlaceholder: e.g. city at night, coffee pour
broll.addResult: Add footage by {credit} at the playhead
broll.noResults: Nothing found for “{query}”. Try a simpler, more visual search.
broll.noRoom: There's B-roll at the playhead already. Move the playhead to a free spot.
broll.suggested: Added {count, plural, one {# B-roll clip} other {# B-roll clips}}.
broll.nothingSuggested: Nothing new to add: no other moment names something filmable.
broll.unavailable: Stock footage isn't set up on this server, so B-roll can't be added.

ai.label: Ask AI to edit this clip
ai.placeholder: Edit with AI, e.g. remove the filler words
ai.editedMeanwhile: You edited the clip while the AI worked, so its change wasn't applied yet.
ai.timeout: The AI took too long. Try again.
ai.failed: Couldn't reach the AI. Try again.
ai.title: AI edit
ai.remaining: {remaining} of {limit} AI edits left this month.
ai.subscriptionRequired: AI editing requires Pro or Creator.

recovery.sourceIncomplete: The editing copy of this clip is only {duration} long instead of {expected}, so part of the clip is missing here. Your generated clip isn't affected. Rebuild the editing copy to fix it.
recovery.rebuildDescription: SupoClip prepares this clip again from the original video, at its full length and with the framing it was generated with.
recovery.rebuildWarning: Studio edits you made to this clip don't carry over to the new copy. Your current draft is kept on our servers: download it any time with “Download previous draft” in the ⋯ menu.
recovery.backupsDescription: Your drafts save to your SupoClip account. This browser also keeps a small copy of changes that haven't reached the server yet, in case the tab closes or you go offline, plus a short undo history for your last few clips. Deleting projects doesn't change this storage.
recovery.backupsSummary: {entries, plural, =0 {No clips have a browser backup} one {# clip has a browser backup} other {# clips have a browser backup}} ({size})
recovery.backupsUnsaved: {count, plural, =0 {All of them are already saved to your account.} one {# has changes that aren't in your account yet. It is kept.} other {# have changes that aren't in your account yet. They are kept.}}
recovery.backupsClearNote: Removing saved copies only forgets their undo history after a reload. Your drafts stay in your account.
recovery.backupsNothing: Nothing to remove. Unsaved changes stay until they reach your account.
recovery.backupsBrowserNote: Clearing this browser's site data for SupoClip also removes these copies and signs you out. Only do that once every open clip says “All changes saved”.

captionTemplates.title: Template
captionTemplates.description: Sets how captions move. The font and colours below still apply.
captionTemplates.animatedHint: Drawn frame by frame. Accents land on the moments that matter.

fx.title: Dynamic edits
fx.description: The AI marks the moments that matter. Intensity sets how hard each one hits.
fx.noMusicBed: No track fits this mood yet. Try another mood.

intensityHint.off: No automatic edits. Edits you added yourself stay.
intensityHint.subtle: Reframes now and then and a quiet music bed.
intensityHint.bold: Punch-ins on the key moments, hits on some cuts.
intensityHint.max: Fast reframes, louder hits and music.

needsPlan.title: Plan this clip first
needsPlan.body: The AI reads the transcript and marks the beats the edits land on. It takes a few seconds and uses one of today's plans.

errors.notAvailable: Dynamic edits aren't available on your account yet.
errors.planLimit: You've planned edits as often as you can today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.workerUnavailable: The AI service didn't answer. Try planning again.
errors.invalidStyle: That combination of settings isn't supported.
errors.resolveFailed: Couldn't apply the edits. Try again.
errors.timeout: Planning took too long. Try again.
errors.changedMeanwhile: The draft kept changing, so the edits weren't applied. Try again.

sfx.label: Sound effects
sfx.hint: Short hits and pops on cuts and graphics

music.label: Music
music.hint: A bed that ducks under the voice

zooms.label: Zooms
zooms.hint: Reframes and short pushes on the key moments

shake.label: Camera shake
shake.hint: A jolt on the hardest hits

transitions.label: Transitions
transitions.hint: A rare flash where the clip cuts

speed.label: Speed ramps and freezes
speed.hint: Speed through set-ups, freeze before a payoff

progress_bar.label: Progress bar
progress_bar.hint: A thin bar along the bottom edge

loop_ending.label: Loop ending
loop_ending.hint: Fades the end into the start so it replays smoothly

reactions.label: GIF reactions
reactions.hint: A reaction GIF on the funniest moments

beats.title: Beats
beats.description: The moments the AI tagged. Jump to one, change what it is or delete it, and the edits follow.

cue.title: Selected edit
cue.editHint: Changing an AI edit makes it yours, so re-planning keeps it.
cue.holdBudget: Freezes can hold {seconds}s in total on this clip.
cue.label: Label

remove.hint: Clears every edit, beat, music bed and grade on this clip. Undo brings them back.
remove.done: Edits removed. Undo brings them back.

look.title: Look
look.description: A colour grade and film grain over the whole clip.

fxTimeline.suppressedHint: Auto edits you delete stay off when the edits are re-planned

fxTimeline.cueTitle: {kind} · {time}. Drag to move, double-click to open.
